verses.text: Dhritarashtra said: O Sanjaya, assembled on the field of dharma, the field of the Kurus, eager for battle, what did my sons and the sons of Pandu do?
Sanjaya said: Seeing the Pandava army arrayed in battle formation, Duryodhana approached his teacher Drona and spoke these words.
Behold, O teacher, this mighty army of the sons of Pandu, arranged by your own gifted disciple, the son of Drupada.
Arjuna inquired: Which are considered to be more perfect, those who are always properly engaged in Your devotional service or those who worship the impersonal Brahman, the unmanifested?

The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: Those who fix their minds on Me and always engage in devotional service with full faith, considering Me the supreme goal, are considered by Me to be most perfect.
But those who fully worship the unmanifested, that which lies beyond the perception of the senses, the all-pervading, inconceivable, unchanging, fixed and immovable.
Sanjaya said: To him who was thus overcome with compassion, whose eyes were full of tears and who was despondent, Madhusudana spoke these words.
The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: My dear Arjuna, how have these impurities come upon you? They are not at all befitting a man who knows the value of life.
Do not yield to this degrading impotence. It does not become you. Give up such petty weakness of heart and arise, O chastiser of the enemy.
